description: Read-only counterfactual cost comparison for the same closed virtual positions. Monthly fees are charged once per active Moscow calendar month in the combined view.

panels.title: Cost-adjusted paper performance - no broker orders

panels.description: Sum of entry and exit notional for closed virtual positions in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, notional, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, notional, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)) SELECT COALESCE(sum(notional) * 2, 0)::double precision AS "Executed Turnover" FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring});

panels.title: Executed Turnover

panels.description: Strategy result before commission, slippage, and subscription costs.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)) SELECT COALESCE(sum(gross_pnl), 0)::double precision AS "Gross PnL" FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring});

panels.title: Gross PnL Before Costs

panels.description: Best counterfactual scenario for selected portfolios and range. Fee-waived profiles require the corresponding T-Bank eligibility conditions.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring})), tariffs(tariff, commission_rate, monthly_fee) AS (VALUES ('Investor', 0.003::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Trader paid', 0.0005::numeric, 390::numeric), ('Trader free', 0.0005::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Premium paid', 0.0004::numeric, 2990::numeric), ('Premium free', 0.0004::numeric, 0::numeric)), summary AS (SELECT COALESCE(sum(notional) * 2, 0) AS turnover, COALESCE(sum(gross_pnl), 0) AS gross_pnl, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', exit_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')) AS active_months FROM filtered) SELECT tariff AS metric, (gross_pnl - turnover * (commission_rate + 0.0005) - active_months * monthly_fee)::double precision AS value FROM summary CROSS JOIN tariffs ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Best Net PnL Scenario

panels.description: Closed virtual positions included in the comparison.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)) SELECT count(*) AS "Closed Positions" FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring});

panels.title: Closed Positions

panels.description: Combined account-level comparison. Subscription is charged once per active Moscow calendar month.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring})), tariffs(tariff, commission_rate, monthly_fee) AS (VALUES ('Investor', 0.003::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Trader paid', 0.0005::numeric, 390::numeric), ('Trader free', 0.0005::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Premium paid', 0.0004::numeric, 2990::numeric), ('Premium free', 0.0004::numeric, 0::numeric)), summary AS (SELECT count(*) AS closed_positions, COALESCE(sum(notional) * 2, 0) AS turnover, COALESCE(sum(gross_pnl), 0) AS gross_pnl, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', exit_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')) AS active_months FROM filtered) SELECT tariff, closed_positions, round(turnover, 2) AS turnover, round(gross_pnl, 2) AS gross_pnl, round(turnover * commission_rate, 2) AS broker_commission, round(turnover * 0.0005, 2) AS slippage_cost, round(active_months * monthly_fee, 2) AS subscription_cost, round(gross_pnl - turnover * (commission_rate + 0.0005) - active_months * monthly_fee, 2) AS net_pnl FROM summary CROSS JOIN tariffs ORDER BY net_pnl DESC;

panels.title: Combined Tariff Comparison

panels.description: Higher is better. Uses the same trades and prices for every scenario.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring})), tariffs(tariff, commission_rate, monthly_fee) AS (VALUES ('Investor', 0.003::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Trader paid', 0.0005::numeric, 390::numeric), ('Trader free', 0.0005::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Premium paid', 0.0004::numeric, 2990::numeric), ('Premium free', 0.0004::numeric, 0::numeric)), summary AS (SELECT COALESCE(sum(notional) * 2, 0) AS turnover, COALESCE(sum(gross_pnl), 0) AS gross_pnl, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', exit_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')) AS active_months FROM filtered) SELECT tariff, (gross_pnl - turnover * (commission_rate + 0.0005) - active_months * monthly_fee)::double precision AS net_pnl FROM summary CROSS JOIN tariffs ORDER BY net_pnl DESC;

panels.title: Net PnL by Tariff

panels.description: Monthly account-level PnL after commission, shared slippage assumption, and one subscription charge in months with trades.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)), tariffs(tariff, commission_rate, monthly_fee) AS (VALUES ('Investor', 0.003::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Trader paid', 0.0005::numeric, 390::numeric), ('Trader free', 0.0005::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Premium paid', 0.0004::numeric, 2990::numeric), ('Premium free', 0.0004::numeric, 0::numeric)), monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', exit_time) AS month, sum(notional) * 2 AS turnover, sum(gross_pnl) AS gross_pnl FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1) SELECT month AS time, tariff AS metric, (gross_pnl - turnover * (commission_rate + 0.0005) - monthly_fee)::double precision AS value FROM monthly CROSS JOIN tariffs ORDER BY time, metric;

panels.title: Monthly Net PnL by Tariff

panels.description: Each portfolio is treated as if it traded alone; subscription is therefore charged independently here.

targets.rawSql: WITH positions AS (SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) UNION ALL SELECT portfolio_name, notional, gross_pnl, exit_time FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)), tariffs(tariff, commission_rate, monthly_fee) AS (VALUES ('Investor', 0.003::numeric, 0::numeric), ('Trader paid', 0.0005::numeric, 390::numeric), ('Premium paid', 0.0004::numeric, 2990::numeric)), summary AS (SELECT portfolio_name, count(*) AS closed_positions, sum(notional) * 2 AS turnover, sum(gross_pnl) AS gross_pnl, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', exit_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')) AS active_months FROM positions WHERE portfolio_name IN (${portfolio:sqlstring}) GROUP BY portfolio_name) SELECT portfolio_name, tariff, closed_positions, round(turnover, 2) AS turnover, round(gross_pnl, 2) AS gross_pnl, round(gross_pnl - turnover * (commission_rate + 0.0005) - active_months * monthly_fee, 2) AS net_pnl FROM summary CROSS JOIN tariffs ORDER BY portfolio_name, net_pnl DESC;

panels.title: Standalone Portfolio Economics

panels.description: Approximate monthly executed turnover where the paid tariff on the right becomes cheaper than the paid tariff on the left. Slippage cancels out because it is shared.

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Investor -> Trader paid', 156000::numeric), ('Trader paid -> Premium paid', 26000000::numeric)) AS thresholds(comparison, break_even_turnover);

panels.title: Base Tariff Break-even Turnover

panels.description: Default assumptions: Investor 0.30%, Trader 0.05% + 390 RUB/month, Premium 0.04% + 2,990 RUB/month, and slippage 0.05% per side. Premium 0.015% shown in some product cards applies to futures, not the stock scenarios modeled here. Fee-waived rows are counterfactuals for accounts meeting T-Bank eligibility conditions.

options.content:
## How to read this dashboard

- Same virtual trades and prices in every row
- Commission applies to both entry and exit turnover
- Slippage is separate from broker commission
- Subscription is charged once per active month
- This dashboard never creates broker orders
